whatThisIs: [Department of Immigrant Advancement “strengthens immigrants' ability to fully and equitably participate in Boston's economic, civic, social, and cultural life”. This office offers mainly resources and information to the immigrant community in Boston, be it consultations with the office directly, resources to help finding low-cost legal help, and community office hours that can help connect you to community support.]
whoItHelps: Individuals looking for resource in Boston regarding immigration such as food, housing, immigration referrals, or family services
Individuals looking to receive a free consultation with volunteer lawyers
whatToKnow: The Free phone consultations service due to high demand require calling ahead to make an appointment”,”[MOIA has a thorough resource guide, offered in several languages, that can help direct you to resources in and around boston.”,”Community office hours are located only at  East Boston Library or the Copley Central Library branches
